text: Every time I try to export our monthly board report to CSV, the web app crashes with a blank white screen. Lost 2 hours of work yesterday!
Exporting to PDF fails silently. The spinning wheel runs forever and no file downloads. Our clients need these reports weekly.
CSV export is completely broken for projects with more than 100 tasks. Throws an internal server error every single time.
Love the dashboard views, but the PDF export cuts off the rightmost columns and corrupts data formatting.
Tried exporting data for our board meeting and the CSV export button was completely unresponsive. Had to copy paste manually.
Google Calendar sync keeps disconnecting every 3 days. I miss team meetings because task deadlines do not update on my calendar.
Calendar two-way sync creates duplicate events whenever a teammate reschedules a deadline. My calendar is a mess.
The Google calendar integration constantly shows auth token expired. We have to re-authenticate our entire team every week.
Deadline sync with Outlook and Google Calendar is terribly delayed. Changes take up to 4 hours to reflect on my phone.
Push notifications on iOS are completely broken after updating to iOS 18. Nothing arrives unless the app is actively open.
Mobile app crashes instantly whenever I open a task that has images or PDF attachments. Unusable on iPhone 15.
Notifications arrive 2 hours late. Real-time collaboration is impossible when push alerts are this delayed.
We loved the product until renewal time when our pricing increased by 65% with zero advance notice. We are actively migrating our team to ClickUp.
The mandatory 10-seat minimum is absurd for small boutique agencies. We only have 4 staff members but are forced to pay for 10 full licenses. Will cancel if not resolved.
Hidden per-user charges for integrations like Slack and Jira that used to be free in the standard plan. Greedy pricing model.
Please add a native Slack bot! We want to create tasks and approve milestones directly from Slack channels without opening a browser tab.
Desperately need bi-directional GitHub issues integration so our engineering team does not have to copy tickets back and forth.
Please support Webhooks and Zapier. We want to trigger automated customer emails whenever a milestone status flips to Completed.
Please bring Dark Mode to the desktop web app. Working at night on these bright white screens causes serious eye fatigue.
Dark theme is essential for our engineering team. All other productivity tools we use have dark mode by default.
Customer support is virtually non-existent. Submitted a priority bug ticket 6 days ago and only received generic automated responses.
The AI chatbot on the help center goes in circles and makes it impossible to reach an actual human agent for billing inquiries.
Support team took 4 business days to respond to an account lockout issue during our launch week. Highly disappointed.
The initial onboarding wizard is confusing and assumes you already know how workspace hierarchies work. Needs step-by-step video tutorials.
Inviting new team members sends an email link that frequently expires within 10 minutes, causing endless friction during onboarding.
The Kanban board is incredibly fast and responsive. Our engineering standups run 10x smoother since switching to this tool.
Task dependencies and milestone tracking are hands-down the best in the market. Clean UI and very intuitive.
Search across workspaces is blazing fast. Finding archived client briefs takes seconds now.
The mobile app on Android is smooth and allows me to update task statuses on the train without any lag.
Keyboard shortcuts for creating and assigning subtasks are phenomenal. Power user experience is top tier.
UI is smooth and snappy on small projects, but crawls to a halt when switching between large team workspaces with 50+ members.
Loading times for the analytics dashboard exceed 15 seconds during peak European business hours.
Overall decent task manager, but the pricing jump for growing teams is too steep to recommend to seed stage startups.
Great product for daily task tracking, though we still miss native GitLab and Figma integrations.
Good core functionality. Fix the CSV export crash and notifications bug and this would easily be a 5-star product.
